notes.title: VR DLSS update
notes.content:
Added DLSS comptatibilty for those with nvidia cards and the latest drivers. Offers an effective but slightly blurry anti-aliasing solution that increases performance 30-40%, which can make room for increased view distance and higher quality lighting.

Also made a few more suble changes to controls and optimisation to make the experience a little bit better.

Also - This will be the last VR update for the time being, I've found that making VR games is too tiresome and the final product always seems inferior to the respective desktop version. I've had fun experimenting with VR but it almost never feels rewarding, so I'll be focusing on newer, high fidelity desktop experiences for the near future. Follow me on twitter or instagram for regular updates on what I'm working on:

https://twitter.com/cavesrd
https://www.instagram.com/cavesrd/
https://www.youtube.com/cavesrd

Cheers!
-Matt
